data_window: GitHub Search API and repository README/root-content audit for repositories created since 2026-08-31 or pushed since 2026-09-01. Search snapshots were saved under /tmp/radar_2026_09_03_*.json; selected repository audits were saved under /tmp/radar_2026_09_03_repo_audit/.
source_summary: Queried AI agent, LLM/RAG, MCP agent, browser agent, code agent, and voice assistant surfaces through the GitHub Search API, then reviewed repository metadata, root files, README claims, demos, tests, Docker/package files, and setup instructions for 21 shortlisted repositories. No third-party repository was cloned, installed, built, executed, browser-tested, mobile-tested, provider-tested, credential-tested, safety-tested, or deployed locally.
trend_observations: WebMCP is becoming a product primitive across local folders, storefronts, recovery admin, hardware diagnostics, analytics studios, and repair loops. Human sovereignty is a repeated differentiator through checkout gates, physical actuation approval, browser handoff, repair publishing approval, and local-file privacy. Coding-agent infrastructure is moving from prompts to controllable operating surfaces such as visual graphs, worktrees, session migration, browser/session CLI, and office/desk metaphors. Strongest runnability signals were tests, Docker, smoke commands, demo media, and no-key mock modes.
assumptions: Scores are based on GitHub API metadata plus README/root-content evidence, not local runtime proof. Star and fork counts are raw GitHub API counts at collection time; no 24-hour star-delta API was available in this unauthenticated run. Type-level skips such as prompt collections, pure README catalogues, thin wrappers, classroom tasks, and no-code repositories are described in markdown_report without fabricating GitHub repository entries.
markdown_report: Top focus for 2026-09-03: WebMCP/local-file workspaces, mobile browser agents, visual coding-agent orchestration, browser-owned hardware diagnostics, autonomous software factory loops, human escalation for browser agents, agent-first work databases, job-search agent workspaces, multi-session Chrome control, and WebMCP tool repair. Watchlist covers recovery admin, commerce checkout gates, browser-render MCP, adversarial browser-agent testing, agent config rollback, and teaching shopping agents. Skip reasons cover research harnesses, SDK mirrors, course exercises, showcases, and immature assistant scaffolds.

top_projects.summary: Turns a local folder of PDFs, code, notes, CSVs, screenshots, and images into an in-browser searchable workspace exposed to visiting agents through WebMCP tools.
top_projects.audience: Knowledge workers and developers who want an agent to inspect local files without uploading them.
top_projects.ai_native_angle: The human sees a reader while the agent receives typed tools for status, search, citation, and export against the same browser-owned IndexedDB state.
top_projects.growth_signal: Created 2026-09-02 and pushed 2026-09-02; README includes WebMCP Challenge positioning, Docker, local dev commands, tests, OCR, embeddings, citation UI, and explicit agent-side instructions.
top_projects.runnability: High from README/root audit: Next.js app, npm run dev, Dockerfile, Vitest config, 64 claimed unit tests, and no external server requirement for the core local index.
top_projects.recommended_action: Clone for a focused WebMCP/local-file pattern review; test large-folder indexing and citation-ring UX.

top_projects.summary: Android WebView browser where an autonomous DOM/vision agent can browse, act, verify, and pause for human takeover.
top_projects.audience: Users who want a mobile-first agent browser with persistent cookies, downloads, tabs, and provider fallback.
top_projects.ai_native_angle: Combines hybrid perception, action validation, safety policy, model capability negotiation, human takeover, memory, and red-team/self-test pages inside a browser product.
top_projects.growth_signal: Created 2026-09-02, pushed 2026-09-03; README claims 134 unit tests, Android project files, provider discovery docs, and injection/phish/challenge test pages.
top_projects.runnability: Medium-high: Android Gradle project and docs are present, but this run did not build an APK or verify device permissions.
top_projects.recommended_action: Watch closely; run an Android build and safety-loop smoke test before deeper adoption.

top_projects.summary: Visual node-graph workflow engine for orchestrating Claude Code, Codex, Aider, and other coding agents against isolated Git worktrees.
top_projects.audience: Engineering teams experimenting with multi-agent pipelines, scheduled refactors, QA review agents, and repeatable local automation.
top_projects.ai_native_angle: Agent nodes, tool execution nodes, isolated worktrees, persistent sessions, live CLI streaming, and cron triggers turn coding-agent operations into a product surface.
top_projects.growth_signal: Created and pushed 2026-09-03; root contains Go backend, frontend, images, architecture docs, and README screenshots.
top_projects.runnability: Medium-high: Go module plus frontend directory and CLI/web entrypoint are visible, but no local build was run.
top_projects.recommended_action: Prototype with one repo and two agent nodes; inspect whether host CLI discovery handles Codex safely.

top_projects.summary: Lets an AI agent investigate virtual or physical hardware faults through browser-owned diagnostic instruments and human-approved physical interventions.
top_projects.audience: Hardware labs, embedded developers, and educators who need agent-assisted troubleshooting with explicit verification.
top_projects.ai_native_angle: WebMCP exposes 19 diagnostic tools with red/amber gates, hidden-state firewalling, hypothesis confirmation, and repeatable post-repair tests.
top_projects.growth_signal: Created 2026-09-02, pushed 2026-09-03; TypeScript/Vite/Bun app with server, tests, docs, artifacts, and safety-gated tool descriptions.
top_projects.runnability: Medium-high: bun install and bun run dev path is documented; physical-device paths remain unaudited.
top_projects.recommended_action: Study as a reference for agent tool safety in physical-world workflows.

top_projects.summary: Plans, builds, tests, repairs, browser-QAs, and reports on software inside isolated Solari environments.
top_projects.audience: Agent engineering teams evaluating end-to-end build/repair/verification loops.
top_projects.ai_native_angle: Treats planning, sandbox execution, browser QA, debugging, repair, and engineering-report emission as a single evidence-gated product loop.
top_projects.growth_signal: Created 2026-09-01 and pushed 2026-09-03; README includes dashboard GIF, multiple smoke-test commands, Dockerfile, monorepo packages, docs, examples, and Railway config.
top_projects.runnability: High from docs: mock-provider smoke tests do not require an API key; Solari-backed full path was not credential-tested.
top_projects.recommended_action: Run npm run ai:smoke and npm run demo:repair; compare evidence reports with current internal coding-agent QA loops.

top_projects.summary: Lets a cloud browser agent hand a stuck live session to a human through a phone link, then resume in the same browser session.
top_projects.audience: Teams running browser agents that hit 2FA, login, payment, or sensitive approval moments.
top_projects.ai_native_angle: Adds a first-class human takeover/approval protocol to agent browsing, preserving cookies, page state, and task continuity.
top_projects.growth_signal: Created 2026-09-01, pushed 2026-09-03; README shows npm install, API snippets, demo/benchmarks/e2e/tests, CI badge, and measured rescue claims.
top_projects.runnability: Medium: npm package shape is strong, but the primary path depends on a Solari API key.
top_projects.recommended_action: Keep on watch for browser-agent operations; test with a non-sensitive 2FA-style workflow.

top_projects.summary: Self-hosted work platform with tables, relations, formulas, workflows, documents, REST, CLI, and built-in MCP server over one SQLite file.
top_projects.audience: Small teams that want Airtable/Notion-like work management where agents and humans operate the same data model.
top_projects.ai_native_angle: UI, REST API, CLI, and MCP expose the same engine; undo tooling acknowledges agent mistakes as a normal workflow.
top_projects.growth_signal: Created 2026-08-16 and pushed 2026-09-03; README has screenshots, quickstart, MCP positioning, tests, docs, and zero-runtime-dependency claim.
top_projects.runnability: High from root audit: package scripts, test directory, public assets, docs, and wrangler example are present; runtime not executed.
top_projects.recommended_action: Compare against the radar board's own project-pool needs; consider as a future agent-operated table substrate.

top_projects.summary: Privacy-conscious self-hosted job application assistant with tailored resumes, reports, web app, CLI, browser extension, Docker, and local data.
top_projects.audience: Job seekers who want agent help while retaining data control and repeatable application records.
top_projects.ai_native_angle: Combines local operator CLI, multi-user web app, browser extension, reports, and provider-compatible AI behind a self-hosted workflow.
top_projects.growth_signal: Created 2026-09-02 and pushed 2026-09-02; repo includes Docker Compose, Caddy, tests, docs, demo, templates, extension, and CI.
top_projects.runnability: High from root audit: uv run cli.py serve --public, Docker Compose, and .env.example are documented.
top_projects.recommended_action: Run locally with dummy data; inspect extension permissions and resume/report generation quality.

top_projects.summary: Creates isolated Chrome sessions with separate profiles, debugging ports, sockets, CDP passthrough, screenshots, DOM snapshots, and network capture.
top_projects.audience: Developers and agent operators who need concurrent browser sessions without login/state bleed.
top_projects.ai_native_angle: Makes browser state a named, scriptable resource for agents, with no focus stealing and automatic wrapper recovery.
top_projects.growth_signal: Created and pushed 2026-09-03; README includes npm install, CLI examples, tests, assets, TypeScript source, and Chinese README.
top_projects.runnability: Medium-high: package and Vitest config are present, but it depends on local Chrome/Chromium and chrome-devtools-mcp.
top_projects.recommended_action: Trial as a local browser isolation layer for recurring research automations.

top_projects.summary: Phoenix LiveView demo where an agent reports a broken WebMCP tool, a human approves a bounded repair, the browser hot-swaps the tool, and the same agent retries with a receipt.
top_projects.audience: Builders of browser-owned agent tools who need repair, approval, and evidence loops.
top_projects.ai_native_angle: The product centers on generation/version receipts, human approval, deterministic canaries, browser-observed tool changes, and verified reports.
top_projects.growth_signal: Created 2026-09-01, pushed 2026-09-03; README includes local setup, Docker/Postgres files, WebMCP docs, tests, and fallback demo mode.
top_projects.runnability: Medium: strong setup docs, but local path needs Elixir/Phoenix plus PostgreSQL.
top_projects.recommended_action: Extract the receipt/verifier pattern for agent tool registries; run only after dependency setup.

watchlist.ai_native_angle: WebMCP tools are scoped to staged, local, human-approved recovery actions.

watchlist.runnability: Medium-high: npm app and WebMCP tools are present; real checkout is intentionally simulated.
